d1_sqlite_master.name: business_purchase_failed
d1_sqlite_master.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER business_purchase_failed AFTER UPDATE OF status ON commerce_purchases
WHEN NEW.status='failed' AND OLD.status != NEW.status
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO business_event_outbox(event_id,event_type,occurred_ts,payload)
 SELECT 'payment.failed:' || NEW.payment_id,'payment.failed',NEW.updated_at,
 json_object('payment_id',NEW.payment_id,'quote_id',NEW.quote_id,'sku',q.sku,
 'product_version_ref',q.version,'artifact_hash',q.content_hash,
 'exact_amount_atomic',q.amount_usdc_micros,'payment_network',q.network)
 FROM commerce_quotes q WHERE q.id=NEW.quote_id
 ON CONFLICT(event_id) DO NOTHING;
END

 FROM commerce_quotes q WHERE q.id=NEW.quote_id

 INSERT INTO business_event_outbox(event_id,event_type,occurred_ts,payload)
 SELECT 'receipt.issued:' || NEW.payment_id,'receipt.issued',NEW.updated_at,

 'product_version_ref',q.version,'artifact_hash',q.content_hash,
 'exact_amount_atomic',q.amount_usdc_micros,'payment_network',q.network)
 FROM commerce_quotes q WHERE q.id=NEW.quote_id
 ON CONFLICT(event_id) DO NOTHING;
 INSERT INTO business_event_outbox(event_id,event_type,occurred_ts,payload)
 SELECT 'entitlement.activated:' || NEW.payment_id,'entitlement.activated',NEW.updated_at,
 json_object('payment_id',NEW.payment_id,'quote_id',NEW.quote_id,'sku',q.sku,

 json_object('trial_id',NEW.trial_id,'scope_hash',NEW.scope_hash,
 'sku',json_extract(NEW.scope_json,'$.sku'),
 'selected_share_bps',json_extract(NEW.scope_json,'$.selected_share_bps'),
 'exact_amount_atomic',json_extract(NEW.scope_json,'$.amount_atomic')));
END

d1_sqlite_master.name: component_trial_finished
d1_sqlite_master.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER component_trial_finished AFTER UPDATE OF status ON component_trials
WHEN OLD.status='running' AND NEW.status IN ('completed','failed')
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO business_event_outbox(event_id,event_type,occurred_ts,payload)
 VALUES('trial.'||NEW.status||':'||NEW.id,'trial.'||NEW.status,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
 json_object('trial_id',NEW.id,'sku',NEW.sku,'product_version_ref',NEW.version,'release_hash',NEW.release_hash));
END

d1_sqlite_master.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER component_trial_started AFTER INSERT ON component_trials
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO business_event_outbox(event_id,event_type,occurred_ts,payload)
 VALUES('trial.started:'||NEW.id,'trial.started',NEW.created_at,
 json_object('trial_id',NEW.id,'sku',NEW.sku,'product_version_ref',NEW.version,'release_hash',NEW.release_hash));
END

pipelines.name: secondwind_telemetry
pipelines.sql:
INSERT INTO all_events_sink
SELECT event_id, schema_version, event_contract_version, event_type, occurred_ts,
       actor_id, visitor_id, session_id, journey_id, request_id, buyer_id, payload
FROM second_wind_events;

INSERT INTO identity_events_sink
SELECT event_id, occurred_ts, actor_id, visitor_id, session_id, buyer_id, payload
FROM second_wind_events WHERE event_type = 'identity.linked';

INSERT INTO decision_runs_sink
SELECT event_id, occurred_ts, session_id, journey_id, request_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.decision_run_id') AS decision_run_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.disposition') AS disposition,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.objective') AS objective,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.model') AS model,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.state_hash') AS state_hash,
       json_get_int(payload, '$.tokens_in') AS tokens_in,
       json_get_int(payload, '$.tokens_out') AS tokens_out
FROM second_wind_events WHERE event_type = 'decision.run';

INSERT INTO decision_answers_sink
SELECT event_id, occurred_ts,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.decision_run_id') AS decision_run_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.question_id') AS question_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.answer') AS answer,
       json_get_float(payload, '$.confidence') AS confidence
FROM second_wind_events WHERE event_type = 'decision.answer';

INSERT INTO decision_options_sink
SELECT event_id, occurred_ts,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.decision_run_id') AS decision_run_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.question_id') AS question_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.option_key') AS option_key,
       json_get_float(payload, '$.probability') AS probability
FROM second_wind_events WHERE event_type = 'decision.option';

INSERT INTO decision_reductions_sink
SELECT event_id, occurred_ts,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.decision_run_id') AS decision_run_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.action') AS action,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.status') AS status,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.reducer_version') AS reducer_version
FROM second_wind_events WHERE event_type = 'decision.reduction';

INSERT INTO catalog_events_sink
SELECT event_id, occurred_ts, session_id, journey_id, request_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.sku') AS sku,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.product_version_id') AS product_version_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.catalog_snapshot_id') AS catalog_snapshot_id,
       json_get_int(payload, '$.max_price_bps') AS max_price_bps
FROM second_wind_events WHERE event_type IN ('catalog.selected','catalog.no_match');

INSERT INTO scope_events_sink
SELECT event_id, occurred_ts, session_id, journey_id, request_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.product_version_id') AS product_version_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.unit_key') AS unit_key,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.scope_hash') AS scope_hash,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.price_digest') AS price_digest,
       json_get_int(payload, '$.final_price_bps') AS final_price_bps
FROM second_wind_events WHERE event_type IN ('scope.activated','scope.frozen');

INSERT INTO commerce_events_sink
SELECT event_id, occurred_ts, session_id, journey_id, request_id, buyer_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.sku') AS sku,
       json_get_int(payload, '$.price_bps') AS price_bps
FROM second_wind_events WHERE event_type = 'commerce.checkout_initiated';

INSERT INTO meter_events_sink
SELECT event_id, occurred_ts, session_id, journey_id, request_id, buyer_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.unit_key') AS unit_key,
       json_get_int(payload, '$.unit_price_bps') AS unit_price_bps,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.scope_hash') AS scope_hash,
       CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS query_hash, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS burned,
       CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS queries_used, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS queries_remaining,
       CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS metering_version
FROM second_wind_events WHERE event_type = 'meter.line_item';

INSERT INTO meter_events_sink
SELECT event_id, occurred_ts, session_id, journey_id, request_id, buyer_id,
       CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS unit_key, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS unit_price_bps,
       CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS scope_hash,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.query_hash') AS query_hash,
       json_get_int(payload, '$.burned') AS burned,
       json_get_int(payload, '$.queries_used') AS queries_used,
       json_get_int(payload, '$.queries_remaining') AS queries_remaining,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.metering_version') AS metering_version
FROM second_wind_events WHERE event_type = 'meter.query';

INSERT INTO guard_events_sink
SELECT event_id, occurred_ts, session_id, journey_id, request_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.guard') AS guard,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.verdict') AS verdict
FROM second_wind_events WHERE event_type = 'guard.evaluated';

INSERT INTO execution_events_sink
SELECT event_id, occurred_ts, session_id, journey_id, request_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.sandbox_id') AS sandbox_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.language') AS language,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.runtime') AS runtime,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.build_status') AS build_status
FROM second_wind_events WHERE event_type IN ('execution.sandbox_started','execution.build_validated');

INSERT INTO payment_events_sink
SELECT event_id, occurred_ts, session_id, journey_id, request_id, buyer_id,
       json_get_int(payload, '$.amount_bps') AS amount_bps,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.asset') AS asset,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.network') AS network,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.settlement_reference') AS settlement_reference,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.outcome') AS outcome
FROM second_wind_events WHERE event_type = 'payment.settle';

INSERT INTO receipt_events_sink
SELECT event_id, occurred_ts, session_id, journey_id, request_id, buyer_id,
       json_get_int(payload, '$.price_bps') AS price_bps,
       json_get_int(payload, '$.max_price_bps') AS max_price_bps,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.scope_hash') AS scope_hash,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.price_digest') AS price_digest,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.settlement_reference') AS settlement_reference
FROM second_wind_events WHERE event_type = 'receipt.issued';

INSERT INTO delivery_events_sink
SELECT event_id, occurred_ts, session_id, journey_id, request_id, buyer_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.artifact_id') AS artifact_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.receipt_id') AS receipt_id
FROM second_wind_events WHERE event_type = 'delivery.completed';

INSERT INTO recovery_events_sink
SELECT event_id, occurred_ts, session_id, journey_id, request_id, buyer_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.recovery_kind') AS recovery_kind,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.receipt_id') AS receipt_id,
       json_get_str(payload, '$.outcome') AS outcome
FROM second_wind_events WHERE event_type = 'recovery.attempted';
